vocabulary.definitionEn: To state or show that something is definitely true or correct.
vocabulary.example: Please confirm your attendance by Friday.
vocabulary.exampleVi: Vui lòng xác nhận tham dự trước thứ Sáu.

vocabulary.definitionEn: To change the time or date of a planned event.
vocabulary.example: We had to reschedule the meeting for Thursday.
vocabulary.exampleVi: Chúng tôi phải dời cuộc họp sang thứ Năm.

vocabulary.definitionEn: A document listing goods or services supplied and the amount owed.
vocabulary.example: The invoice was sent to the wrong department.
vocabulary.exampleVi: Hoá đơn đã bị gửi nhầm sang phòng khác.

vocabulary.definitionEn: A company or person that provides goods or services.
vocabulary.example: We have switched to a local supplier for packaging.
vocabulary.exampleVi: Chúng tôi đã chuyển sang nhà cung cấp bao bì trong nước.

vocabulary.definitionEn: A quantity of goods sent together to a destination.
vocabulary.example: The shipment cleared customs yesterday morning.
vocabulary.exampleVi: Lô hàng đã thông quan sáng hôm qua.

vocabulary.definitionEn: To send a file together with an email message.
vocabulary.example: I have attached the revised floor plan.
vocabulary.exampleVi: Tôi đã đính kèm bản vẽ mặt bằng đã sửa.

vocabulary.meaningVi: bên bán, đơn vị bán hàng
vocabulary.definitionEn: A company that sells a product or service to another company.
vocabulary.example: Three vendors submitted quotations for the contract.
vocabulary.exampleVi: Ba bên bán đã nộp báo giá cho hợp đồng này.

vocabulary.definitionEn: The latest time by which something must be finished.
vocabulary.example: The deadline for expense claims is the fifth of each month.
vocabulary.exampleVi: Hạn chót nộp đề nghị hoàn chi phí là ngày 5 hằng tháng.

vocabulary.definitionEn: Money returned to a customer, especially for faulty or unwanted goods.
vocabulary.example: Customers may request a full refund within thirty days.
vocabulary.exampleVi: Khách hàng có thể yêu cầu hoàn tiền đầy đủ trong vòng ba mươi ngày.

vocabulary.definitionEn: The work of keeping equipment or a building in good condition.
vocabulary.example: Routine maintenance is scheduled for the first Sunday of each month.
vocabulary.exampleVi: Bảo trì định kỳ được xếp vào Chủ nhật đầu tiên mỗi tháng.

vocabulary.definitionEn: A document proving that goods or money have been received.
vocabulary.example: Keep your receipt in case you need to exchange the item.
vocabulary.exampleVi: Giữ biên lai phòng khi bạn cần đổi hàng.

vocabulary.definitionEn: Able to be used or obtained; free to meet or talk.
vocabulary.example: Are you available for a short call at four?
vocabulary.exampleVi: Bốn giờ anh có rảnh để gọi ngắn không?

activities.title: Part 1 — Photographs
activities.format: TOEIC Listening — Part 1 · Photographs, 6 câu, bốn lựa chọn, chỉ nghe không có chữ
activities.instructionsVi: Nhìn ảnh rồi nghe bốn câu mô tả, chọn câu đúng nhất. Trong đề thi thật bốn lựa chọn KHÔNG in trên giấy. Ảnh ở đây được mô tả bằng chữ để luyện; bẫy chính là câu dùng đúng từ có trong ảnh nhưng sai hành động.
activities.promptEn:
Look at each photograph and listen to the four statements. Select the statement that best describes what you see.

PHOTO 1: A man in an apron stands behind a bakery counter, placing a loaf of bread into a paper bag. Trays of pastries are arranged in front of him. No customers are visible.

PHOTO 2: Two women sit opposite each other at an outdoor café table. One is pointing at a document on the table; the other is holding a pen. Two cups sit at the edge of the table.

PHOTO 3: A row of bicycles is parked along a railing on a city street. None of them is being ridden. A pedestrian walks past in the background.

PHOTO 4: A worker on a ladder is repairing a light fixture on a ceiling. Below him, a second worker holds the ladder steady with both hands.

PHOTO 5: A crowded platform at a train station. People are standing behind a yellow line, several looking down the track. A train is not yet visible.

PHOTO 6: An empty meeting room. Chairs are arranged around a long table, a projector screen is pulled down, and bottles of water have been placed at each seat.

transcript.speaker: Photo 1
transcript.text: (A) He's putting bread into a bag. (B) He's eating a pastry. (C) He's cleaning the counter. (D) He's serving a customer.

transcript.speaker: Photo 2
transcript.text: (A) They're drinking from the same cup. (B) They're looking at a document. (C) They're standing near a table. (D) They're writing on a whiteboard.

transcript.speaker: Photo 3
transcript.text: (A) Bicycles are being repaired. (B) A man is riding a bicycle. (C) Bicycles have been parked in a row. (D) People are removing a railing.

transcript.speaker: Photo 4
transcript.text: (A) One of the men is climbing down. (B) A ladder is being held by a worker. (C) They're carrying a light fixture. (D) The ceiling is being painted.

transcript.speaker: Photo 5
transcript.text: (A) Passengers are boarding a train. (B) People are waiting on a platform. (C) The platform has been closed. (D) A train is pulling into the station.

transcript.speaker: Photo 6
transcript.text: (A) A meeting is in progress. (B) Chairs are being stacked. (C) The room has been prepared for a meeting. (D) Someone is adjusting the screen.

questions.prompt: Photo 1

options.text: He's putting bread into a bag.

questions.explanationVi: Ảnh cho thấy người đàn ông đang bỏ bánh mì vào túi giấy. (D) sai vì ảnh ghi rõ không có khách nào — bẫy suy diễn từ bối cảnh tiệm bánh.

questions.prompt: Photo 2

options.text: They're drinking from the same cup.

questions.explanationVi: Một người chỉ vào tài liệu, người kia cầm bút. (B) sai vì họ NGỒI chứ không đứng — Part 1 rất hay bẫy ở động từ tư thế.

questions.prompt: Photo 3

options.text: A man is riding a bicycle.
Bicycles have been parked in a row.

questions.explanationVi: Ảnh không có người nào đang tác động tới xe, nên phải dùng thì hoàn thành bị động 'have been parked'. (A) dùng 'are being repaired' đòi hỏi phải có người đang sửa trong ảnh.

questions.prompt: Photo 4

options.text: One of the men is climbing down.
A ladder is being held by a worker.

questions.explanationVi: Người thứ hai đang giữ thang bằng hai tay, nên 'is being held' đúng vì có người thực hiện hành động. (A) sai vì người trên thang đang SỬA đèn, không leo xuống.

questions.prompt: Photo 5

options.text: A train is pulling into the station.
People are waiting on a platform.

questions.explanationVi: Ảnh ghi rõ tàu CHƯA xuất hiện, nên (A) và (C) đều loại. Đây là bẫy kinh điển: nghe thấy 'train station' rồi chọn phương án có từ 'train'.

questions.prompt: Photo 6

options.text: The room has been prepared for a meeting.

questions.explanationVi: Phòng trống nên mọi phương án có người đang hành động đều sai. Ảnh không người thì đáp án gần như luôn ở thì hoàn thành bị động.

activities.title: Part 2 — Question–Response
activities.format: TOEIC Listening — Part 2 · Question–Response, 25 câu, ba lựa chọn, chỉ nghe không có chữ
activities.instructionsVi: Nghe một câu hỏi hoặc câu trần thuật rồi chọn phản hồi hợp lý nhất trong ba lựa chọn. Trong đề thi thật ba lựa chọn KHÔNG in trên giấy. Ba bẫy chính: lặp lại từ vừa nghe, dùng từ đồng âm, và trả lời sai loại câu hỏi.
activities.promptEn: You will hear a question or statement followed by three responses. Choose the most appropriate response for each of the 25 items.

transcript.text: Where did you leave the delivery forms?
When does the new branch open?
Who's presenting at the sales meeting?
Why was the shipment returned?
How many people signed up for the workshop?
Would you like me to call the supplier?
The printer on the second floor isn't working.
Should we take the train or drive to the conference?
Have you finished the quarterly report yet?
Isn't the office closed on Monday?
Could you send me the updated price list?
Where's the nearest post office?
I thought Ms Delgado was leading this project.
How long will the renovation take?
Why don't we move the meeting to the afternoon?
Do you know if the invoice has been paid?
What time does the store close on Saturdays?
This is the third time the system has crashed.
Who should I speak to about parking permits?
Are the samples ready to be shipped?
You've already booked the venue, haven't you?
Would you rather work Saturday or Sunday?
The catering order needs to be confirmed today.
How did the client respond to the proposal?
Where are we storing the old files?

questions.prompt: 7. Where did you leave the delivery forms?

options.text: On your desk, next to the printer.

questions.explanationVi: Câu hỏi 'Where' cần địa điểm. (A) lặp gốc từ 'deliver', (C) trả lời Yes cho câu hỏi Wh- và lặp từ 'left'.

questions.prompt: 8. When does the new branch open?
questions.explanationVi: 'When' cần thời gian. (A) trả lời nơi chốn, (B) trả lời số lượng — cả hai đều sai loại câu hỏi.

questions.prompt: 9. Who's presenting at the sales meeting?
questions.explanationVi: 'Who' cần tên người. (C) lặp từ 'sales' nhưng không trả lời gì.

questions.prompt: 10. Why was the shipment returned?

options.text: Three of the boxes were damaged.
By the end of the week.

questions.explanationVi: 'Why' cần lý do. (B) trả lời thời gian, (C) trả lời nơi chốn.

questions.prompt: 11. How many people signed up for the workshop?
questions.explanationVi: 'How many' cần con số. (A) lặp gốc từ 'sign' nhưng khác nghĩa hoàn toàn — bẫy đồng âm điển hình.

questions.prompt: 12. Would you like me to call the supplier?

options.text: That would be a big help.

questions.explanationVi: Đây là lời ĐỀ NGHỊ giúp đỡ, cần phản hồi chấp nhận hoặc từ chối. (A) và (C) lặp từ khoá nhưng không đáp lại lời đề nghị.

questions.prompt: 13. The printer on the second floor isn't working.

options.text: Have you told the IT desk?
My office is on the second floor.

questions.explanationVi: Câu trần thuật nêu vấn đề, phản hồi hợp lý là gợi ý hành động. (C) lặp nguyên cụm 'second floor' — bẫy lặp từ.

questions.prompt: 14. Should we take the train or drive to the conference?

options.text: Driving would be cheaper for four of us.

questions.explanationVi: Câu hỏi lựa chọn 'A or B' không trả lời bằng Yes/No, nên (C) loại ngay. Phải chọn một bên, tốt nhất là kèm lý do.

questions.prompt: 15. Have you finished the quarterly report yet?

options.text: Almost — I need one more figure.

questions.explanationVi: Trả lời một phần ('gần xong') là dạng đáp án đúng rất phổ biến. (A) trả lời như thể được hỏi 'How often'.

questions.prompt: 16. Isn't the office closed on Monday?

options.text: It's open, but only until noon.
I close at five every day.

questions.explanationVi: Câu hỏi phủ định vẫn trả lời theo sự thật. (C) bắt bẻ vào từ 'Monday' thay vì trả lời về giờ mở cửa.

questions.prompt: 17. Could you send me the updated price list?

options.text: The prices went up in March.
I sent it to the wrong address.
Sure, I'll email it this afternoon.

questions.explanationVi: Đây là YÊU CẦU, cần lời đồng ý kèm mốc thời gian. (B) nghe liên quan nhưng nói về một việc đã xảy ra, không đáp lại yêu cầu.

questions.prompt: 18. Where's the nearest post office?

options.text: It closes at half past five.
Two streets down, on the left.
I need to post these letters.

questions.explanationVi: 'Where' cần chỉ đường. (C) lặp gốc từ 'post' — bẫy đồng âm.

questions.prompt: 19. I thought Ms Delgado was leading this project.

options.text: She was, until she transferred to Madrid.

questions.explanationVi: Câu trần thuật nêu giả định sai, phản hồi đúng là đính chính kèm giải thích.

questions.prompt: 20. How long will the renovation take?
questions.explanationVi: 'How long' hỏi thời lượng. (B) lặp từ 'long' nhưng hiểu theo nghĩa độ dài không gian — bẫy đa nghĩa.

questions.prompt: 21. Why don't we move the meeting to the afternoon?

options.text: Good idea — I'll let everyone know.

questions.explanationVi: 'Why don't we…' là lời ĐỀ NGHỊ, không phải câu hỏi lý do. (B) trả lời như thể hỏi 'why' — đây chính là bẫy của dạng này.

questions.prompt: 22. Do you know if the invoice has been paid?

options.text: Accounts would know better than me.

questions.explanationVi: Chuyển câu hỏi sang người khác là dạng trả lời gián tiếp hợp lệ và rất hay xuất hiện. (A) lặp gốc từ 'pay'.

questions.prompt: 23. What time does the store close on Saturdays?

options.text: The store is on Hill Street.

questions.explanationVi: 'What time' cần giờ. (B) trả lời về ngày khác, dùng đúng từ 'closed' nhưng lệch thông tin — bẫy đổi chi tiết.

questions.prompt: 24. This is the third time the system has crashed.

options.text: Three of us use that system.
The car crashed on the motorway.
I know — they're upgrading it next week.

questions.explanationVi: Câu than phiền cần phản hồi đồng cảm kèm thông tin. (A) bám vào số 'third/three', (B) bám vào từ 'crash' theo nghĩa khác.

questions.prompt: 25. Who should I speak to about parking permits?

options.text: I parked in the visitor bay.

questions.explanationVi: 'Who' cần người hoặc bộ phận. (B) và (C) đều lặp từ khoá của câu hỏi mà không trả lời.

questions.prompt: 26. Are the samples ready to be shipped?
questions.explanationVi: Trả lời phủ định có điều kiện ('chưa, phải đợi nhãn') là dạng đáp án đúng thường bị bỏ qua vì không bắt đầu bằng No.

questions.prompt: 27. You've already booked the venue, haven't you?

options.text: The book is on the shelf.

questions.explanationVi: Câu hỏi đuôi cần xác nhận có sắc thái. (A) lặp gốc từ 'book' theo nghĩa quyển sách, (C) lặp từ 'venue' mà không trả lời đã đặt hay chưa.

questions.prompt: 28. Would you rather work Saturday or Sunday?
questions.explanationVi: Câu hỏi lựa chọn có thể trả lời bằng 'sao cũng được'. (C) sai vì câu hỏi lựa chọn không dùng Yes/No.

questions.prompt: 29. The catering order needs to be confirmed today.

options.text: I'll do it before I leave.

questions.explanationVi: Câu trần thuật hàm ý yêu cầu, phản hồi đúng là nhận việc. (C) lặp gốc từ 'order' và trả lời như thể được hỏi số lượng.

questions.prompt: 30. How did the client respond to the proposal?
questions.explanationVi: 'How did they respond' hỏi NỘI DUNG phản hồi, không hỏi phương tiện. (B) hiểu 'how' theo nghĩa cách thức — bẫy tinh vi nhất trong nhóm này.

questions.prompt: 31. Where are we storing the old files?
questions.explanationVi: 'Where' cần nơi chốn. (B) lặp gốc từ 'file' và trả lời về cách sắp xếp thay vì vị trí.

activities.title: Part 3 — Conversation 1: a late delivery
activities.instructionsVi: Nghe hội thoại rồi trả lời 3 câu. Trong đề thật bạn có khoảng 8 giây đọc trước câu hỏi. Ba câu luôn theo thứ tự: đầu đoạn, giữa đoạn, rồi việc sắp làm.
activities.promptEn: Listen to the conversation and answer questions 32 through 34.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Hi Marcus, do you have a second? It's about the Delaney order.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: The one going out today?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: It was meant to. The courier just called — their van broke down outside Reading and they can't collect until tomorrow morning.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: That's a problem. Delaney's shop opens on Friday and they need stock on the shelves by Thursday.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: I know. If they collect at eight tomorrow it still arrives Thursday afternoon, but there's no margin at all.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Then let's not rely on it. I'll ring Delaney now and tell them what's happened before they hear it from the courier.

questions.prompt: 32. What is the problem?

options.text: A shop has cancelled its opening.
A courier's vehicle has broken down.
An order was sent to the wrong address.
A product is out of stock.

questions.explanationVi: 'their van broke down outside Reading'. Vấn đề nằm ở phía đơn vị vận chuyển, không phải ở hàng hoá.

questions.prompt: 33. Why is the delay serious?

options.text: The order will be cancelled automatically.
The customer's shop opens on Friday.

questions.explanationVi: 'Delaney's shop opens on Friday and they need stock on the shelves by Thursday'.

questions.prompt: 34. What will the man do next?
questions.explanationVi: 'I'll ring Delaney now'. Câu cuối của Part 3 gần như luôn hỏi hành động kế tiếp.

activities.title: Part 3 — Conversation 2: booking a training room
activities.instructionsVi: Nghe rồi trả lời 3 câu. Đoạn này có một chỗ người nói tự sửa lại thông tin — nghe hụt là mất điểm.
activities.promptEn: Listen to the conversation and answer questions 35 through 37.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Facilities, this is Ade.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Hi Ade. I need a room for a training session on the fourteenth, for about twenty people.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Twenty. The Boardroom takes eighteen, so that's out. Training Room A takes thirty — let me check the fourteenth. Sorry, I'm looking at the wrong month. The fourteenth… yes, it's free all day.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Great. Does it have a projector?

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: It does, but the bulb is being replaced next week. I'd bring a laptop and use the large screen instead, just in case.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Fine. Can you put it in the calendar and send me the room code?

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Will do. I'll email it this afternoon.

questions.prompt: 35. Why is the Boardroom unsuitable?

options.text: It is already booked on the fourteenth.
It does not have a projector.
It holds fewer people than required.

questions.explanationVi: 'The Boardroom takes eighteen, so that's out' — cần chỗ cho hai mươi người. Phải so hai con số.

questions.prompt: 36. What does the man suggest about the projector?

options.text: That she book a different room
That she request a new bulb herself
That the woman bring a laptop and use the screen instead

questions.explanationVi: 'I'd bring a laptop and use the large screen instead, just in case' — vì bóng đèn máy chiếu sắp được thay.

questions.prompt: 37. What will the man send?
questions.explanationVi: 'send me the room code' — 'I'll email it this afternoon'.

activities.title: Part 3 — Conversation 3: at a hotel reception
activities.instructionsVi: Nghe rồi trả lời 3 câu. Chú ý phân biệt điều khách YÊU CẦU với điều lễ tân thực sự ĐÁP ỨNG được.
activities.promptEn: Listen to the conversation and answer questions 38 through 40.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Good afternoon. I have a reservation under Okafor, checking in today.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Let me see… yes, three nights, a standard room on the fourth floor.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: I'd asked for a quiet room away from the lift, if that's possible.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: I can see the note. The fourth floor is fully booked, I'm afraid, but I can move you to the sixth — same room type, and it's at the far end of the corridor.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: That works. One more thing: is breakfast included?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Not on this rate, but you can add it for twelve pounds a morning, and it's cheaper if you pay for all three nights now.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: I'll take all three then.

questions.prompt: 38. What had the man requested in advance?

options.text: A room on the fourth floor
A room away from the lift

questions.explanationVi: 'I'd asked for a quiet room away from the lift'. Tầng bốn là phòng đã đặt sẵn, không phải yêu cầu của khách.

questions.prompt: 39. What does the woman offer to do?

options.text: Upgrade him to a larger room
Give him a discount on the room rate
Move him to the sixth floor
Extend his stay by one night

questions.explanationVi: 'I can move you to the sixth — same room type'. Bà ấy nói rõ CÙNG hạng phòng, nên (A) sai.

questions.prompt: 40. What does the man decide about breakfast?

options.text: It is already included in his rate.
He will pay for all three mornings now.

questions.explanationVi: 'it's cheaper if you pay for all three nights now' — 'I'll take all three then'.

activities.title: Part 3 — Conversation 4: three speakers, staffing a stand
activities.format: TOEIC Listening — Part 3 · Conversation 4, ba người nói (câu 41–43)
activities.instructionsVi: Hội thoại BA người. Câu hỏi thường hỏi ý kiến của một người cụ thể, nên phải theo dõi ai nói gì chứ không chỉ nhớ nội dung.
activities.promptEn: Listen to the conversation among three speakers and answer questions 41 through 43.

transcript.speaker: W1
transcript.text: So, the trade fair stand. We need two people on it at all times, and it runs three days.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: I can do Wednesday and Thursday, but not Friday — I've got the audit that morning.

transcript.speaker: W2
transcript.text: I'm free all three days. But I've never done a stand before, so I'd rather not be on it alone.

transcript.speaker: W1
transcript.text: You won't be. I'll take Friday with you. That leaves Wednesday and Thursday covered by you two.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Do we have the new brochures? Last year we ran out by lunchtime on day one.

transcript.speaker: W1
transcript.text: Five hundred ordered, arriving Monday. I'll bring them over myself so they don't sit in the post room.

questions.prompt: 41. Why can the man not work on Friday?

options.text: He has never worked on a stand.
He has an audit that morning.

questions.explanationVi: 'not Friday — I've got the audit that morning'. (A) là lo ngại của người phụ nữ thứ hai, không phải của ông ta.

questions.prompt: 42. What concern does the second woman raise?

options.text: She does not want to staff the stand alone.
She thinks five hundred brochures is too few.
She has another event that week.

questions.explanationVi: 'I've never done a stand before, so I'd rather not be on it alone'.

questions.prompt: 43. What will the first woman do with the brochures?

options.text: Leave them in the post room
Deliver them to the stand herself
Send them directly to the venue

questions.explanationVi: 'I'll bring them over myself so they don't sit in the post room'. (B) chính là điều bà ấy muốn TRÁNH.

activities.title: Part 3 — Conversation 5: a job applicant calls
activities.instructionsVi: Nghe rồi trả lời 3 câu. Có một chi tiết được nêu dưới dạng điều kiện — bỏ qua điều kiện là chọn sai dù nghe đúng con số.
activities.promptEn: Listen to the conversation and answer questions 44 through 46.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Hello, Brightmoor Recruitment.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Hi, I applied for the warehouse supervisor post last week. I wanted to check whether you'd received my references.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Let me look. We have one from Hartley Logistics… but the second one hasn't come through.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: That'll be from my previous manager. He's been on leave.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: That's fine — we can shortlist you with one reference, as long as the second arrives before the interview stage. Interviews are the week of the twentieth.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: I'll chase him today. Is there anything else outstanding?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Just the forklift certificate. Email a scan and I'll add it to your file.

questions.prompt: 44. Why is the man calling?

options.text: To check whether his references have arrived

questions.explanationVi: 'I wanted to check whether you'd received my references'.

questions.prompt: 45. Under what condition can he be shortlisted with one reference?

options.text: If he provides a forklift certificate
If his former manager returns from leave
If he applies again after the twentieth
If the second reference arrives before the interview stage

questions.explanationVi: 'as long as the second arrives before the interview stage'. Đây là điều kiện, không phải lời hứa vô điều kiện.

questions.prompt: 46. What is the man asked to send?

options.text: A scan of his forklift certificate

questions.explanationVi: 'Just the forklift certificate. Email a scan'.

activities.title: Part 3 — Conversation 6: returning a faulty item
activities.instructionsVi: Nghe rồi trả lời 3 câu. Câu hỏi thứ hai hỏi HÀM Ý của một câu nói, không hỏi nghĩa đen.
activities.promptEn: Listen to the conversation and answer questions 47 through 49.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Hi, I bought this kettle here three weeks ago and it's stopped heating.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Sorry to hear that. Do you have the receipt?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: I've got the card statement, not the paper receipt.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Well, that's not ideal. But three weeks is inside our thirty-day window, and the statement shows the store and the amount, so I can look it up.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Would I get a refund or a replacement?

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Either. Though I'd say we've had four of that model back this month, so I'd take the refund and choose something else.

questions.prompt: 47. What is the problem with the product?
questions.explanationVi: 'I bought this kettle here three weeks ago and it's stopped heating'.

questions.prompt: 48. What does the man mean when he says, 'that's not ideal'?

options.text: The purchase is outside the return window.
A card statement is acceptable but less convenient than a receipt.
The kettle cannot be returned at all.
He does not believe the customer.

questions.explanationVi: Ngay sau đó ông ta nói 'But three weeks is inside our thirty-day window… so I can look it up'. Câu 'not ideal' chỉ là nói giảm, không phải từ chối.

questions.prompt: 49. What does the man recommend?

options.text: Taking a replacement of the same model
Waiting until the receipt is found
Taking a refund and choosing a different product

questions.explanationVi: 'we've had four of that model back this month, so I'd take the refund and choose something else'.

activities.title: Part 3 — Conversation 7: rearranging a site visit
activities.instructionsVi: Nghe rồi trả lời 3 câu. Có hai mốc thời gian được nhắc tới và một trong hai bị thay đổi — bám vào lượt nói cuối cùng.
activities.promptEn: Listen to the conversation and answer questions 50 through 52.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Priya, are we still visiting the Kingsbury site on Tuesday?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: That was the plan, but the contractor asked to move it. They're pouring concrete Tuesday and the yard will be closed.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Wednesday, then?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Wednesday I'm in Manchester all day. Thursday morning would work — say ten o'clock.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Ten's fine. How long should I allow?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Two hours for the walk-round, plus travel. It's about forty minutes each way, so block out the whole morning.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: I'll update the calendar and let the contractor know.

questions.prompt: 50. Why was the original date changed?

options.text: Concrete is being poured and the yard will be closed.
The woman will be in Manchester.
The contractor has cancelled the project.
The man is unavailable on Tuesday.

questions.explanationVi: 'They're pouring concrete Tuesday and the yard will be closed'. (B) là lý do loại thứ Tư, không phải thứ Ba — bẫy ghép sai lý do với ngày.

questions.prompt: 51. When will the visit take place?
questions.explanationVi: 'Thursday morning would work — say ten o'clock'.

questions.prompt: 52. How much time does the woman advise setting aside?
questions.explanationVi: Hai tiếng đi bộ khảo sát cộng bốn mươi phút mỗi chiều, nên bà ấy kết luận 'block out the whole morning'.

activities.title: Part 3 — Conversation 8: an expenses query
activities.instructionsVi: Nghe rồi trả lời 3 câu. Đoạn này có một quy định kèm ngoại lệ; câu hỏi nhắm đúng vào ngoại lệ đó.
activities.promptEn: Listen to the conversation and answer questions 53 through 55.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Hi, I'm querying an expense claim that was rejected. The taxi from the airport.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Let me check the reference… I see. Taxis aren't reimbursed when public transport is available on the route.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: My flight landed at half past midnight. There were no trains.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Ah — that's the exception, and it wasn't recorded. If you resubmit with the flight arrival time on the claim, it'll go through.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Do I need the boarding pass as well?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: The booking confirmation is enough, as long as it shows the arrival time. Resubmit by the fifth and it's in this month's run.

questions.prompt: 53. Why was the claim originally rejected?

options.text: It was submitted after the deadline.
Taxi fares are not reimbursed where public transport runs.

questions.explanationVi: 'Taxis aren't reimbursed when public transport is available on the route'.

questions.prompt: 54. What makes this claim an exception?

options.text: The flight arrived when no trains were running.
The man travelled for a client meeting.
The taxi was booked by the company.
The man had approval in advance.

questions.explanationVi: 'My flight landed at half past midnight. There were no trains' — 'that's the exception'.

questions.prompt: 55. What must the man include when he resubmits?
questions.explanationVi: 'The booking confirmation is enough, as long as it shows the arrival time'. Thẻ lên máy bay được nói rõ là KHÔNG cần.

activities.title: Part 3 — Conversation 9: choosing a caterer
activities.instructionsVi: Nghe rồi trả lời 3 câu. Có hai lựa chọn kèm ưu nhược; câu hỏi hỏi lý do quyết định chứ không hỏi giá.
activities.promptEn: Listen to the conversation and answer questions 56 through 58.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: We've got two quotes for the launch event. Fenwick is nine hundred, Marchetti is eleven fifty.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: For the same number of guests?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Both for eighty. But Marchetti includes staff to serve and clear; with Fenwick we'd be doing that ourselves.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: That changes it. We'd need three people for the evening, and I'd rather they were talking to guests.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Agreed. Marchetti also did the summer event and there were no complaints.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Then let's go with them. Can you confirm before Friday? They said the date isn't held after that.

questions.prompt: 56. What is included in the more expensive quote?
questions.explanationVi: 'Marchetti includes staff to serve and clear'. Số khách là như nhau (80) nên (A) sai.

questions.prompt: 57. Why does the man prefer that option?

options.text: Their own staff can talk to guests instead of serving.
The food is of higher quality.
It can be booked at short notice.

questions.explanationVi: 'We'd need three people for the evening, and I'd rather they were talking to guests'.

questions.prompt: 58. What must be done before Friday?

options.text: The guest list must be finalised.
A second quote must be obtained.

questions.explanationVi: 'Can you confirm before Friday? They said the date isn't held after that'.

activities.title: Part 3 — Conversation 10: a software rollout
activities.instructionsVi: Nghe rồi trả lời 3 câu. Người nói dùng cách nói giảm nhẹ để bày tỏ nghi ngờ — câu hỏi hàm ý nhắm vào đó.
activities.promptEn: Listen to the conversation and answer questions 59 through 61.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: The vendor says the whole rollout can be done in two weekends.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Two weekends. Well, they're certainly optimistic.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: You don't think it's realistic?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Not with sixty machines and no test environment. The last upgrade took a month and that was a smaller change.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: So what would you propose?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Do one department first — Accounts, they're the smallest — and see what breaks. If that goes cleanly in a weekend, the estimate might hold. If it doesn't, we've learned it cheaply.

questions.prompt: 59. What does the woman mean when she says, 'they're certainly optimistic'?

options.text: She agrees the schedule is achievable.
She is pleased with the vendor's attitude.
She thinks the estimate is unrealistic.

questions.explanationVi: Cách nói mỉa. Ngay sau đó bà ấy giải thích rõ lý do: 60 máy, không có môi trường thử, lần nâng cấp trước mất một tháng.

questions.prompt: 60. What reason does she give for her doubt?

options.text: The budget has not been approved.
There are sixty machines and no test environment.

questions.explanationVi: 'Not with sixty machines and no test environment'.

questions.prompt: 61. What does she propose?

options.text: Extending the deadline to a month

questions.explanationVi: 'Do one department first — Accounts, they're the smallest — and see what breaks'.

activities.title: Part 3 — Conversation 11: with a table of options
activities.format: TOEIC Listening — Part 3 · Conversation 11, kèm bảng trên đề (câu 62–64)
activities.instructionsVi: Dạng 'Look at the graphic'. Người nói KHÔNG đọc ra đáp án, mà mô tả gián tiếp để bạn tự đối chiếu với bảng. Đọc bảng trước khi băng chạy.
activities.promptEn:
Listen to the conversation and answer questions 62 through 64. Refer to the price list below where indicated.

MEETING ROOM HIRE — half day
Room A (8 seats) — £60
Room B (16 seats) — £95
Room C (24 seats) — £140
Room D (40 seats) — £210

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: How many are coming to the supplier briefing?

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Twenty confirmed, and two more said they'd try.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: So we need something that takes at least twenty-two. The next size up from that is what I'd book.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Fine. Is that within budget? We were given a hundred and fifty.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Just about, with ten pounds to spare. Though that's for the room only — tea and coffee is extra.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Leave the refreshments then. We can put a kettle in the corner.

questions.prompt: 62. Look at the graphic. Which room will they book?
questions.explanationVi: Cần chỗ cho ít nhất 22 người. Room B chỉ 16, nên phải lên Room C (24 chỗ). Con số phòng không được đọc ra, phải tự đối chiếu bảng.

questions.prompt: 63. What is the budget for the room?
questions.explanationVi: 'We were given a hundred and fifty'. 140 là giá phòng, không phải ngân sách — bẫy đổi chỗ hai con số.

questions.prompt: 64. What do they decide about refreshments?

options.text: To order tea and coffee from the venue
To ask suppliers to bring their own
To skip them and bring a kettle

questions.explanationVi: 'Leave the refreshments then. We can put a kettle in the corner'.

activities.title: Part 3 — Conversation 12: a customer complaint call
activities.instructionsVi: Nghe rồi trả lời 3 câu. Chú ý phân biệt điều khách hàng ĐÒI với điều nhân viên thực sự có thẩm quyền làm.
activities.promptEn: Listen to the conversation and answer questions 65 through 67.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: I've been charged twice for the same subscription. Two payments of forty-nine pounds on the same day.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: I can see both. That's a duplicate — I'm sorry. I'll refund one of them now.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: And I'd like some compensation for the inconvenience. I spent forty minutes on hold earlier.

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: I understand, and I've noted the wait time. I can't authorise compensation myself, but I'll pass it to my supervisor and someone will come back to you within two working days.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: How long will the refund take?

transcript.speaker: M
transcript.text: Three to five working days, depending on your bank. You'll get an email confirming it today.

questions.prompt: 65. What is the woman's problem?

options.text: She was charged twice for one subscription.
Her subscription was cancelled by mistake.
She was charged the wrong amount.
She did not receive a confirmation email.

questions.explanationVi: 'Two payments of forty-nine pounds on the same day' — trùng lặp, không phải sai số tiền.

questions.prompt: 66. What does the man say about compensation?

options.text: He will add it to the refund immediately.
It is not available in this case.
He must refer it to his supervisor.
She must write in to request it.

questions.explanationVi: 'I can't authorise compensation myself, but I'll pass it to my supervisor'. Ông ta không từ chối, chỉ nói không đủ thẩm quyền.

questions.prompt: 67. How long will the refund take?
questions.explanationVi: 'Three to five working days, depending on your bank'. Hai ngày làm việc là thời hạn phản hồi về BỒI THƯỜNG, không phải hoàn tiền.

activities.title: Part 3 — Conversation 13: planning a staff survey
activities.instructionsVi: Hội thoại cuối của Part 3. Ba người, có một điểm bất đồng được giải quyết ở lượt nói cuối.
activities.promptEn: Listen to the conversation among three speakers and answer questions 68 through 70.

transcript.speaker: M1
transcript.text: For the staff survey — do we make it anonymous or not?

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Anonymous. People won't be honest about their manager otherwise.

transcript.speaker: M2
transcript.text: I take that point, but then we can't follow up on anything specific. Last year someone reported a safety issue and we couldn't ask which site.

transcript.speaker: W
transcript.text: Fair. What if it's anonymous by default, with an optional box for people who are happy to be contacted?

transcript.speaker: M2
transcript.text: That works for me.

transcript.speaker: M1
transcript.text: Good. I'll draft it that way and circulate it Monday. Aim to send it out the first week of next month.

questions.prompt: 68. What are the speakers deciding?

options.text: Whether the survey should be anonymous
Which company should run the survey
Whether to hold a survey at all

questions.explanationVi: 'do we make it anonymous or not?' là câu mở đầu và là chủ đề của cả đoạn.

questions.prompt: 69. What objection does the second man raise?

options.text: Specific issues cannot be followed up.
Anonymous surveys take longer to analyse.
Staff will not complete the survey.

questions.explanationVi: 'we can't follow up on anything specific', kèm ví dụ vụ an toàn năm ngoái không biết ở cơ sở nào.

questions.prompt: 70. What compromise is agreed?

options.text: The survey will not be anonymous.
Two separate surveys will be sent.
Anonymous by default, with an optional contact box.

questions.explanationVi: 'anonymous by default, with an optional box for people who are happy to be contacted'.

activities.title: Part 4 — Talk 1: store announcement
activities.instructionsVi: Bài nói một chiều, không có ai hỏi lại nên mọi thông tin chỉ xuất hiện một lần. Ba câu theo thứ tự đầu, giữa, cuối bài.
activities.promptEn: Listen to the announcement and answer questions 71 through 73.

transcript.speaker: Announcer
transcript.text: Attention shoppers. The store will be closing in thirty minutes, at eight o'clock.

transcript.speaker: Announcer
transcript.text: Please note that the customer service desk closes fifteen minutes earlier than the store, so if you need a return or an exchange, please make your way there now.

transcript.speaker: Announcer
transcript.text: A reminder that our sale on winter clothing continues until Sunday, with a further ten per cent off already reduced items when you use a loyalty card.

transcript.speaker: Announcer
transcript.text: Finally, the lift to the car park is out of service this evening. The stairs at the north end of the building remain open, and staff are available at the exit if you need assistance. Thank you for shopping with us.

questions.prompt: 71. When does the customer service desk close?
questions.explanationVi: Cửa hàng đóng lúc 8 giờ, quầy dịch vụ đóng 'fifteen minutes earlier' — tức 7:45. Phải tự tính, con số không được đọc ra.

questions.prompt: 72. What is required for the extra discount?
questions.explanationVi: 'a further ten per cent off already reduced items when you use a loyalty card'.

questions.prompt: 73. What problem is mentioned?

options.text: The lift is out of service.

questions.explanationVi: 'the lift to the car park is out of service this evening'. Cầu thang được nói rõ là VẪN mở, nên (C) sai.

activities.title: Part 4 — Talk 2: voicemail from a dentist
activities.instructionsVi: Tin nhắn thoại. Dạng này gần như luôn có một yêu cầu hành động ở cuối và ít nhất một thông tin bị sửa lại giữa chừng.
activities.promptEn: Listen to the telephone message and answer questions 74 through 76.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Good morning, this is Sandra calling from Fairview Dental Practice for Mr Adeyemi.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: I'm calling about your appointment with Dr Lin, which was booked for Thursday the ninth at four fifteen.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Unfortunately Dr Lin is now attending a training course that week. We can offer you the same time on Thursday the sixteenth, or an earlier slot on Tuesday the seventh at nine in the morning.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: Please call us back on 0161 447 2290 to let us know which you prefer. If we don't hear from you by Friday, we'll release the slot to someone on the waiting list.

transcript.speaker: Caller
transcript.text: One other thing — please remember to bring the list of medication we asked for last time. Thank you.

questions.prompt: 74. Why is the appointment being changed?

options.text: The patient asked to move it.
The practice is closed that week.
The dentist will be on a training course.

questions.explanationVi: 'Dr Lin is now attending a training course that week'.

questions.prompt: 75. What happens if the patient does not reply by Friday?

options.text: The slot will be offered to someone else.

questions.explanationVi: 'we'll release the slot to someone on the waiting list'.

questions.prompt: 76. What is the patient reminded to bring?
questions.explanationVi: 'please remember to bring the list of medication we asked for last time'.

activities.title: Part 4 — Talk 3: radio traffic report
activities.instructionsVi: Bản tin giao thông. Nhiều địa danh và con số nối nhau rất nhanh; ghi nhanh trong lúc nghe thay vì cố nhớ.
activities.promptEn: Listen to the traffic report and answer questions 77 through 79.

transcript.speaker: Reporter
transcript.text: And now the travel news at half past eight.

transcript.speaker: Reporter
transcript.text: There are long delays on the eastbound A40 following an earlier collision near junction twelve. Two lanes are now open, but traffic is queuing back around four miles.

transcript.speaker: Reporter
transcript.text: Drivers heading into the city are advised to leave at junction ten and follow the ring road instead. That adds about fifteen minutes but avoids the queue entirely.

transcript.speaker: Reporter
transcript.text: On the railways, services between Central and Hartwell are running normally again after yesterday's signal failure.

transcript.speaker: Reporter
transcript.text: And a reminder that the Bridge Street car park is closed all week for resurfacing. The nearest alternative is the multi-storey on Ellis Road.

questions.prompt: 77. What has caused the delays on the A40?
questions.explanationVi: 'following an earlier collision near junction twelve'. Signal failure là chuyện của đường sắt — bẫy ghép sai nguyên nhân.

questions.prompt: 78. What are drivers advised to do?

options.text: Leave at junction ten and use the ring road

questions.explanationVi: 'leave at junction ten and follow the ring road instead'. Junction 12 là nơi xảy ra tai nạn.

questions.prompt: 79. What is said about the Bridge Street car park?

options.text: It closes at half past eight.

questions.explanationVi: 'the Bridge Street car park is closed all week for resurfacing'.

activities.title: Part 4 — Talk 4: introducing a speaker
activities.instructionsVi: Bài giới thiệu diễn giả. Câu hỏi thường hỏi nghề nghiệp, thành tựu, và việc sẽ diễn ra ngay sau đó.
activities.promptEn: Listen to the introduction and answer questions 80 through 82.

transcript.speaker: Host
transcript.text: Good evening and welcome to the Riverside Business Forum.

transcript.speaker: Host
transcript.text: It's my pleasure to introduce tonight's speaker, Dr Amara Sesay. Dr Sesay spent twelve years in logistics before moving into research, and she now leads the supply chain group at Northfield University.

transcript.speaker: Host
transcript.text: Her book on resilience after disruption was published last spring and has since been translated into six languages.

transcript.speaker: Host
transcript.text: She'll be speaking for about forty minutes, and we'll then take questions for a further twenty. If you'd like to ask something, there are cards on each table — write your question down and a steward will collect them during the talk.

transcript.speaker: Host
transcript.text: Please join me in welcoming Dr Sesay.

questions.prompt: 80. What did the speaker do before entering research?
questions.explanationVi: 'Dr Sesay spent twelve years in logistics before moving into research'.

questions.prompt: 81. What is said about her book?

options.text: It will be published next spring.
It is available at the entrance.
It has been translated into six languages.

questions.explanationVi: 'published last spring and has since been translated into six languages'. Chú ý 'last', không phải 'next'.

questions.prompt: 82. How should the audience ask questions?

options.text: By writing them on cards during the talk
By raising their hands after the talk
By speaking to a steward at the end

questions.explanationVi: 'write your question down and a steward will collect them during the talk'.

activities.title: Part 4 — Talk 5: automated telephone message
activities.instructionsVi: Tin nhắn tự động của tổng đài. Nhiều lựa chọn bấm phím nối nhau; câu hỏi hỏi phải bấm số nào cho tình huống cụ thể.
activities.promptEn: Listen to the recorded message and answer questions 83 through 85.

transcript.speaker: Recording
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Halcyon Insurance. Please listen carefully as our options have changed.

transcript.speaker: Recording
transcript.text: To make a new claim, press one. To check the status of an existing claim, press two. For renewals and changes to your policy, press three.

transcript.speaker: Recording
transcript.text: If you are calling about a payment that has failed, please do not press any of these options — stay on the line and you will be connected directly to our accounts team.

transcript.speaker: Recording
transcript.text: Please note that our offices are closed on public holidays, and that calls are recorded for training purposes.

transcript.speaker: Recording
transcript.text: You can also manage most policy changes yourself through the customer portal on our website, which is available at any time.

questions.prompt: 83. What should a caller do about a failed payment?

options.text: Call back after a public holiday

questions.explanationVi: 'please do not press any of these options — stay on the line'. Câu phủ định ngay trước là chỗ quyết định.

questions.prompt: 84. Which option is for changing a policy?
questions.explanationVi: 'For renewals and changes to your policy, press three'.

questions.prompt: 85. What alternative does the message suggest?
questions.explanationVi: 'manage most policy changes yourself through the customer portal on our website'.

activities.title: Part 4 — Talk 6: staff briefing
activities.instructionsVi: Bài phổ biến nội bộ. Có một thông tin in sai trên giấy được đính chính bằng lời — dạng bẫy quen thuộc của Part 4.
activities.promptEn: Listen to the briefing and answer questions 86 through 88.

transcript.speaker: Manager
transcript.text: Morning everyone. Three things before you start.

transcript.speaker: Manager
transcript.text: First, the fire drill. It's on Wednesday, not Tuesday as printed on the notice board — I'll have that corrected today. Assembly point is the far end of the car park, as usual.

transcript.speaker: Manager
transcript.text: Second, we're trialling a new stock scanner on aisle four this week. If it misreads anything, don't override it — write the item down and give the list to me at the end of your shift.

transcript.speaker: Manager
transcript.text: And third, the annual leave request form has moved online. Paper forms won't be accepted from the first of next month.

transcript.speaker: Manager
transcript.text: That's all. If you've got questions about the scanner, catch me before eleven — I'm off site after that.

questions.prompt: 86. When will the fire drill take place?
questions.explanationVi: 'It's on Wednesday, not Tuesday as printed on the notice board'. Thứ Ba là thông tin SAI trên bảng tin.

questions.prompt: 87. What should staff do if the scanner misreads an item?

options.text: Write the item down and report it

questions.explanationVi: 'don't override it — write the item down and give the list to me'. Câu phủ định loại thẳng (B).

questions.prompt: 88. What is changing about leave requests?

options.text: They must be approved by two managers.
They can no longer be submitted in advance.
They must be submitted online from next month.
They will be handled by head office.

questions.explanationVi: 'the annual leave request form has moved online. Paper forms won't be accepted from the first of next month'.

activities.title: Part 4 — Talk 7: museum tour introduction
activities.instructionsVi: Bài mở đầu tour. Chú ý phân biệt điều được PHÉP làm và điều bị CẤM, vì chúng nằm sát nhau trong bài.
activities.promptEn: Listen to the tour introduction and answer questions 89 through 91.

transcript.speaker: Guide
transcript.text: Welcome to the Ashworth Textile Museum. My name is Rob and I'll be with you for the next hour.

transcript.speaker: Guide
transcript.text: We'll start on the ground floor with the weaving machines, then go up to the first floor where the workers' cottages have been reconstructed.

transcript.speaker: Guide
transcript.text: Photography is fine anywhere in the building, but please don't use flash on the first floor — the fabrics up there fade very easily.

transcript.speaker: Guide
transcript.text: At the end of the tour we finish in the mill yard, where there's a café and a shop. Your ticket includes a hot drink, so do hold on to it.

transcript.speaker: Guide
transcript.text: One last thing: the floors upstairs are original and quite uneven, so please take care, and let me know if anyone would prefer to take the lift.

questions.prompt: 89. What is on the first floor?
questions.explanationVi: 'up to the first floor where the workers' cottages have been reconstructed'. Máy dệt ở tầng trệt.

questions.prompt: 90. What restriction applies to photography?

options.text: Flash may not be used on the first floor.
It is banned throughout the museum.
It is allowed only in the mill yard.

questions.explanationVi: 'Photography is fine anywhere... but please don't use flash on the first floor'. Chỉ cấm đèn flash, không cấm chụp ảnh.

questions.prompt: 91. Why should visitors keep their ticket?

options.text: It is needed to use the lift.
It gives a discount in the shop.
It must be shown when leaving.

questions.explanationVi: 'Your ticket includes a hot drink, so do hold on to it'.

activities.title: Part 4 — Talk 8: advertisement
activities.instructionsVi: Quảng cáo. Dạng này hay cài điều kiện đi kèm ưu đãi ở cuối, nói rất nhanh — nghe hụt là chọn sai.
activities.promptEn: Listen to the advertisement and answer questions 92 through 94.

transcript.speaker: Voice
transcript.text: Is your business still printing everything in-house? Meridian Print can take that off your hands.

transcript.speaker: Voice
transcript.text: We handle everything from business cards to full exhibition displays, with next-day delivery across the region and a design service if you need one.

transcript.speaker: Voice
transcript.text: This month, new business customers get twenty per cent off their first order, and free delivery on orders over two hundred pounds.

transcript.speaker: Voice
transcript.text: Please note the twenty per cent applies to printing only — design work is charged separately at the standard rate.

transcript.speaker: Voice
transcript.text: Visit meridianprint dot example, or call us on 0800 447 1120 to request a sample pack.

questions.prompt: 92. What service is being advertised?
questions.explanationVi: 'Meridian Print… We handle everything from business cards to full exhibition displays'.

questions.prompt: 93. What does the twenty per cent discount NOT apply to?
questions.explanationVi: 'the twenty per cent applies to printing only — design work is charged separately'. Điều kiện loại trừ nằm ở cuối, nói nhanh.

questions.prompt: 94. How can listeners request a sample pack?

options.text: By placing an order over two hundred pounds
By calling or visiting the website

questions.explanationVi: 'Visit meridianprint dot example, or call us on 0800 447 1120 to request a sample pack'.

activities.title: Part 4 — Talk 9: with a schedule on the test paper
activities.format: TOEIC Listening — Part 4 · Talk 9, kèm bảng trên đề (câu 95–97)
activities.instructionsVi: Dạng 'Look at the graphic'. Người nói mô tả gián tiếp, bạn phải đối chiếu với bảng để tìm đáp án. Đọc bảng TRƯỚC khi băng chạy.
activities.promptEn:
Listen to the talk and answer questions 95 through 97. Refer to the schedule below where indicated.

OPEN DAY PROGRAMME — Saturday
10:00  Welcome talk — Main Hall
11:00  Factory tour — meet at Gate 2
12:30  Lunch — Canteen
14:00  Product demonstration — Workshop B
15:30  Question session — Main Hall

transcript.speaker: Organiser
transcript.text: Thanks for coming, everyone. A few notes before we begin.

transcript.speaker: Organiser
transcript.text: The programme in your pack is accurate except for one item. The session that was due to take place immediately after lunch has had to move to three o'clock, because the machinery is still being serviced.

transcript.speaker: Organiser
transcript.text: Everything else runs as printed. The tour leaves promptly at eleven, so please be at Gate 2 five minutes early — we can't hold it.

transcript.speaker: Organiser
transcript.text: Lunch is included in your ticket. If you have any dietary requirements and haven't told us, please speak to a steward now rather than at half past twelve.

transcript.speaker: Organiser
transcript.text: And the final session will overrun slightly, so if you need to leave by four, that's the one to skip.

questions.prompt: 95. Look at the graphic. Which session has been moved?
questions.explanationVi: Buổi 'immediately after lunch' là Product demonstration lúc 14:00. Người nói không đọc tên buổi, phải tự tra bảng.

questions.prompt: 96. Why should visitors arrive early at Gate 2?

options.text: Because the tour cannot be held for latecomers
Because the gate closes at eleven

questions.explanationVi: 'The tour leaves promptly at eleven, so please be at Gate 2 five minutes early — we can't hold it'.

questions.prompt: 97. What advice is given to those who must leave by four?

options.text: To attend the earlier tour instead
To inform a steward in advance

questions.explanationVi: 'the final session will overrun slightly, so if you need to leave by four, that's the one to skip'.

activities.title: Part 4 — Talk 10: excerpt from a meeting
activities.instructionsVi: Bài cuối của Listening. Có một câu hỏi về hàm ý — người nói không nói thẳng ý mình mà để người nghe tự suy.
activities.promptEn: Listen to the excerpt from a meeting and answer questions 98 through 100.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Right, the customer feedback results. Overall satisfaction is up two points on last quarter, which is good.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: But I want to draw your attention to one number. Satisfaction with delivery times has fallen for the third quarter running, and it's now our lowest-scoring category.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: Now, we did add two new couriers in that period. I'll let you draw your own conclusions about the timing.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: What I'd like from this group is a decision on whether we review the courier contracts now or wait for the next set of figures in April.

transcript.speaker: Speaker
transcript.text: My own view is that waiting costs us another quarter of complaints, but I want to hear the arguments. Let's take fifteen minutes on it.

questions.prompt: 98. What is the overall trend in satisfaction?
questions.explanationVi: 'Overall satisfaction is up two points on last quarter'. Cái GIẢM là riêng hạng mục thời gian giao hàng.

questions.prompt: 99. What does the speaker imply by saying, 'I'll let you draw your own conclusions about the timing'?

options.text: The figures were collected at the wrong time.
The decline is unrelated to delivery.
More data is needed before any conclusion.
The new couriers may be causing the decline.

questions.explanationVi: Ông ta nêu hai sự việc cạnh nhau — điểm giao hàng giảm và việc thêm hai đơn vị vận chuyển cùng kỳ — rồi để người nghe tự nối. Đó là cách nói ám chỉ.

questions.prompt: 100. What decision does the speaker want from the group?

options.text: Whether to change the survey questions
Whether to review courier contracts now or in April

questions.explanationVi: 'a decision on whether we review the courier contracts now or wait for the next set of figures in April'.

activities.title: Part 5 — Incomplete Sentences
activities.format: TOEIC Reading — Part 5 · Incomplete Sentences, 30 câu (101–130)
activities.instructionsVi: Ba mươi câu độc lập, mỗi câu một chỗ trống. Đề thi thật cho 75 phút cho cả Reading, nên Part 5 chỉ nên tốn khoảng 20 giây một câu. Đề luyện siết còn 18 giây để lúc thi bạn dư giờ cho Part 7.
activities.promptEn: Select the best word or phrase to complete each sentence.
activities.passage:
101. The shipment will arrive on Tuesday ______ the ferry is delayed by weather.
102. All expense claims must be submitted ______ the fifth of the month.
103. Ms Okafor asked her assistant ______ the meeting to Thursday.
104. The new printer is far more ______ than the model it replaced.
105. Employees should keep their ______ for any purchase over twenty dollars.
106. The conference room ______ up to forty delegates in theatre style.
107. ______ the heavy rain, the outdoor event went ahead as planned.
108. Please contact the helpdesk ______ you have trouble logging in.
109. The report was ______ detailed that the committee needed an extra week.
110. Mr Nakamura has worked here ______ 2019.
111. All suppliers must comply ______ the revised safety standards.
112. The manager was pleased with the team's ______ of the project.
113. Visitors are ______ to sign in at reception before proceeding.
114. Neither of the two candidates ______ available to start in March.
115. The invoice should be paid within thirty days of ______ .
116. We will need to ______ the budget before the board meeting.
117. The office will be closed on Monday ______ a public holiday.
118. She has been with the company ______ than anyone else on the floor.
119. The training session was postponed ______ low attendance.
120. Please ensure that all documents are filed ______ .
121. The new policy affects ______ employee in the department.
122. The delivery was ______ than we expected, arriving two days early.
123. ______ submitting your application, please review the guidelines.
124. The technician explained ______ the machine had stopped working.
125. Sales figures for the third quarter were ______ higher than forecast.
126. The company is looking for someone ______ can manage a small team.
127. The parcel ______ delivered while you were at lunch.
128. Our office is located ______ the bank and the post office.
129. He asked whether the samples ______ ready for shipping.
130. The seminar was cancelled because ______ people registered.

questions.prompt: 101. The shipment will arrive on Tuesday ______ the ferry is delayed by weather.
questions.explanationVi: 'unless' = trừ khi, nối hai mệnh đề với điều kiện phủ định. 'despite' đi với danh từ, 'because' đảo ngược logic.

questions.prompt: 102. All expense claims must be submitted ______ the fifth of the month.
questions.explanationVi: 'by' = chậm nhất là, dùng cho hạn chót. 'until' chỉ hành động kéo dài liên tục tới thời điểm đó — cặp bẫy phổ biến nhất Part 5.

questions.prompt: 103. Ms Okafor asked her assistant ______ the meeting to Thursday.
questions.explanationVi: Cấu trúc 'ask somebody TO DO something'.

questions.prompt: 104. The new printer is far more ______ than the model it replaced.
questions.explanationVi: Sau 'far more' và trước 'than' cần TÍNH TỪ. Dạng câu hỏi từ loại: nhìn vị trí là đoán được, không cần hiểu nghĩa.

questions.prompt: 105. Employees should keep their ______ for any purchase over twenty dollars.
questions.explanationVi: 'receipts' = biên lai. 'recipes' = công thức nấu ăn — bẫy cặp từ nhìn gần giống nhau.

questions.prompt: 106. The conference room ______ up to forty delegates in theatre style.
questions.explanationVi: Chủ ngữ số ít, thì hiện tại đơn, động từ thêm -s. Câu hỏi hoà hợp chủ ngữ với động từ.

questions.prompt: 107. ______ the heavy rain, the outdoor event went ahead as planned.
questions.explanationVi: Sau chỗ trống là CỤM DANH TỪ ('the heavy rain'), nên phải dùng giới từ 'Despite'. 'Although' cần mệnh đề có động từ.

questions.prompt: 108. Please contact the helpdesk ______ you have trouble logging in.
questions.explanationVi: Quan hệ điều kiện: gặp trục trặc thì liên hệ. 'so' chỉ kết quả, không hợp ở đây.

questions.prompt: 109. The report was ______ detailed that the committee needed an extra week.
questions.explanationVi: Cấu trúc 'so + tính từ + that'. 'such' đi với danh từ ('such a detailed report that…').

questions.prompt: 110. Mr Nakamura has worked here ______ 2019.
questions.explanationVi: 'since' đi với MỐC thời gian, 'for' đi với KHOẢNG thời gian. Hiện tại hoàn thành cộng mốc năm nên chọn 'since'.

questions.prompt: 111. All suppliers must comply ______ the revised safety standards.
questions.explanationVi: 'comply WITH' là giới từ cố định. Dạng câu hỏi giới từ đi kèm động từ phải học thuộc theo cụm.

questions.prompt: 112. The manager was pleased with the team's ______ of the project.
questions.explanationVi: Sau sở hữu cách 'the team's' và trước 'of' cần DANH TỪ.

questions.prompt: 113. Visitors are ______ to sign in at reception before proceeding.
questions.explanationVi: 'are required to' — bị động. Khách là người BỊ yêu cầu, không phải người yêu cầu.

questions.prompt: 114. Neither of the two candidates ______ available to start in March.
questions.explanationVi: 'Neither of…' luôn đi với động từ SỐ ÍT, dù sau đó là danh từ số nhiều. Bẫy hoà hợp kinh điển.

questions.prompt: 115. The invoice should be paid within thirty days of ______ .
questions.explanationVi: Sau giới từ 'of' cần danh từ. 'receipt' ở đây nghĩa là 'việc nhận được', không phải tờ biên lai.

questions.prompt: 116. We will need to ______ the budget before the board meeting.
questions.explanationVi: 'revise' = sửa đổi cho phù hợp. Ba phương án kia gần giống về hình thức nhưng khác hẳn nghĩa.

questions.prompt: 117. The office will be closed on Monday ______ a public holiday.
questions.explanationVi: Sau chỗ trống là cụm danh từ, nên cần 'because of'. 'because' cần mệnh đề có chủ ngữ và động từ.

questions.prompt: 118. She has been with the company ______ than anyone else on the floor.
questions.explanationVi: Có 'than' nên phải dùng dạng SO SÁNH HƠN. 'longest' là so sánh nhất, không đi với 'than'.

questions.prompt: 119. The training session was postponed ______ low attendance.
questions.explanationVi: 'due to' + cụm danh từ, chỉ nguyên nhân. 'although' và 'whereas' cần mệnh đề và mang nghĩa tương phản.

questions.prompt: 120. Please ensure that all documents are filed ______ .
questions.explanationVi: Bổ nghĩa cho động từ 'are filed' nên cần TRẠNG TỪ.

questions.prompt: 121. The new policy affects ______ employee in the department.
questions.explanationVi: 'employee' là danh từ ĐẾM ĐƯỢC SỐ ÍT, chỉ 'every' đi được. 'all', 'most', 'several' đều cần số nhiều.

questions.prompt: 122. The delivery was ______ than we expected, arriving two days early.
questions.explanationVi: Có 'than' nên dùng so sánh hơn. 'fastly' không tồn tại trong tiếng Anh.

questions.prompt: 123. ______ submitting your application, please review the guidelines.
questions.explanationVi: 'Before + V-ing' là cấu trúc chuẩn. 'ago' đứng sau khoảng thời gian, không mở đầu câu.

questions.prompt: 124. The technician explained ______ the machine had stopped working.
questions.explanationVi: Mệnh đề sau đã đủ chủ ngữ và động từ, cần từ nối chỉ LÝ DO. 'what' và 'which' phải làm chủ ngữ hoặc tân ngữ trong mệnh đề.

questions.prompt: 125. Sales figures for the third quarter were ______ higher than forecast.
questions.explanationVi: Bổ nghĩa cho tính từ 'higher' nên cần TRẠNG TỪ.

questions.prompt: 126. The company is looking for someone ______ can manage a small team.
questions.explanationVi: Đại từ quan hệ chỉ NGƯỜI làm chủ ngữ, chọn 'who'. 'which' dùng cho vật, 'whose' chỉ sở hữu.

questions.prompt: 127. The parcel ______ delivered while you were at lunch.
questions.explanationVi: Bị động ở quá khứ: bưu kiện ĐƯỢC giao. Mệnh đề 'while you were at lunch' cố định thì quá khứ.

questions.prompt: 128. Our office is located ______ the bank and the post office.
questions.explanationVi: 'between' dùng cho HAI đối tượng, 'among' cho ba trở lên.

questions.prompt: 129. He asked whether the samples ______ ready for shipping.
questions.explanationVi: Động từ tường thuật 'asked' ở quá khứ nên mệnh đề sau lùi thì. 'samples' số nhiều nên chọn 'were'.

questions.prompt: 130. The seminar was cancelled because ______ people registered.
questions.explanationVi: 'few' = quá ít (nghĩa phủ định), hợp với việc bị huỷ. 'a few' mang nghĩa tích cực là 'có một vài'. 'little' dùng cho danh từ không đếm được.

activities.title: Part 6 — Text 1: car park notice
activities.instructionsVi: Khác Part 5, chỗ trống ở đây phụ thuộc vào NGỮ CẢNH cả đoạn chứ không chỉ vào câu chứa nó. Luôn đọc câu trước và câu sau trước khi chọn. Mỗi văn bản có một câu hỏi chèn nguyên một câu.
activities.promptEn: Read the notice and choose the best option for each numbered blank.
activities.passage:
NOTICE TO ALL STAFF — Car Park Resurfacing

The main car park will be closed for resurfacing from Monday 14 to Friday 18 April. During this period, staff may use the visitor spaces on Colville Street, which will be (131) ______ reserved for employees.

Please note that the barrier there does not read staff cards. Instead, you will need the temporary code, which the facilities team will (132) ______ by email on Friday afternoon.

We expect the work to be completed on schedule. (133) ______

We apologise for the (134) ______ and thank you for your patience.

questions.explanationVi: Cả thông báo nói về việc đóng cửa MỘT TUẦN, nên chỗ đỗ chỉ dành cho nhân viên tạm thời. Trong câu đó cả bốn từ đều hợp ngữ pháp — phải dựa vào ngữ cảnh.
Sau 'will' phải là động từ nguyên mẫu không 'to'. Câu hỏi ngữ pháp thuần tuý, giải quyết trong mười giây.

questions.prompt: 133. — chọn câu phù hợp nhất để chèn vào

options.text: The car park will therefore remain open throughout.
Staff cards will continue to work at the Colville Street barrier.
However, if rain causes a delay, an update will be posted on the intranet each day.
Please submit your parking permit application by Friday.

questions.explanationVi: Câu trước nói kỳ vọng xong đúng hạn, nên câu tiếp theo hợp lý là nêu tình huống ngược lại. (A) và (B) mâu thuẫn trực tiếp với chính thông báo.
'We apologise for the inconvenience' là cụm cố định trong văn bản công sở.

activities.title: Part 6 — Text 2: letter to a client
activities.instructionsVi: Thư thương mại. Chú ý các cụm cố định trong thư từ công việc — TOEIC kiểm tra rất nhiều cụm quen thuộc kiểu này.
activities.promptEn: Read the letter and choose the best option for each numbered blank.
activities.passage:
Dear Mr Halvorsen,

Thank you for your enquiry about our conference facilities for the week of 12 October.

I am pleased to confirm that the Kingsley Suite is (135) ______ on the dates you requested. The room holds up to 120 delegates in theatre style, or 80 with tables.

Our standard package includes audio-visual equipment, refreshments, and a technician on site throughout. (136) ______

Regarding parking, we hold 40 spaces for event guests. (137) ______ demand is high in October, I would recommend reserving these at the time of booking.

I have (138) ______ our full price list. Please let me know if you would like to arrange a site visit.

Yours sincerely,
Rosalind Okonkwo

questions.explanationVi: Sau động từ 'is' cần TÍNH TỪ làm bổ ngữ.

questions.prompt: 136. — chọn câu phù hợp nhất để chèn vào

options.text: Lunch can be added for an additional charge per delegate.
Unfortunately the suite is fully booked that week.
We no longer provide audio-visual equipment.
Payment must be received within seven days of this letter.

questions.explanationVi: Câu trước liệt kê những gì gói dịch vụ ĐÃ bao gồm, nên câu tiếp theo hợp lý là nói về thứ có thể bổ sung. (B) và (C) mâu thuẫn với chính lá thư.
Nhu cầu cao LÀ LÝ DO nên khuyên đặt sớm. Quan hệ nguyên nhân.
Sau 'I have' cần quá khứ phân từ. 'I have enclosed' cũng là cụm chuẩn trong thư thương mại.

activities.title: Part 6 — Text 3: internal memo
activities.instructionsVi: Bản ghi nhớ nội bộ. Có một chỗ trống chỉ chọn đúng nếu bạn đọc thông tin nằm cách đó hai câu.
activities.promptEn: Read the memo and choose the best option for each numbered blank.
activities.passage:
MEMORANDUM
To: All departments
From: IT Services
Subject: Password policy change, effective 1 June

From the first of June, all staff passwords must be changed every ninety days rather than every thirty. This may seem like a (139) ______ of security, but current guidance from the national cyber security centre is that frequent forced changes make passwords weaker, not stronger, because people resort to predictable patterns.

At the same time, the minimum length will (140) ______ from eight characters to twelve. Longer passwords are considerably harder to break, and this change more than offsets the longer interval.

(141) ______ You will receive a reminder seven days before your password expires.

If you have difficulty setting a new password, please contact the helpdesk (142) ______ than attempting to reset it repeatedly, as three failed attempts will lock the account.

questions.explanationVi: Câu tiếp theo bắt đầu bằng 'but' và giải thích rằng đổi mật khẩu thường xuyên lại làm YẾU đi. Nên chỗ trống phải nêu điều người đọc TƯỞNG là suy giảm an ninh.
Từ tám lên mười hai ký tự là TĂNG. Phải đọc hai con số mới chọn đúng.

questions.prompt: 141. — chọn câu phù hợp nhất để chèn vào

options.text: All passwords must be changed today.
The helpdesk will set new passwords for everyone.
No action is needed until your current password expires.
Password length will be reduced to six characters.

questions.explanationVi: Câu ngay sau nói sẽ có nhắc nhở trước bảy ngày khi mật khẩu hết hạn, nên câu chèn phải nói chưa cần làm gì ngay. (A) mâu thuẫn trực tiếp với câu đó.
'rather than' = thay vì. Đây là cụm cố định nối hai lựa chọn.

activities.title: Part 6 — Text 4: job advertisement
activities.instructionsVi: Tin tuyển dụng. Văn bản này có cả câu hỏi từ vựng, ngữ pháp và chèn câu — đúng cấu trúc thường gặp của một đoạn Part 6.
activities.promptEn: Read the advertisement and choose the best option for each numbered blank.
activities.passage:
WAREHOUSE SUPERVISOR — Halloran Distribution, Fairport

We are seeking an experienced supervisor to (143) ______ our evening shift team of twelve.

The successful candidate will have at least three years' experience in a warehouse environment and a valid forklift certificate. Experience with stock management software is (144) ______ but not essential; training will be provided.

This is a permanent position, working Monday to Friday from two until ten. (145) ______

To apply, send a CV and a short covering letter to recruitment at halloran dot example. Applications close on 30 April, and interviews will be held (146) ______ the following week.

activities.title: Part 7 — Single passage 4: online review
activities.instructionsVi: Bài đánh giá. Có câu hỏi chèn câu vào đúng vị trí trong bài — dạng này bắt buộc đọc câu trước và câu sau mỗi vị trí đánh dấu.
activities.promptEn: Refer to the following review and answer the questions.
activities.passage:
Review of Harbour Lodge Hotel — posted by D. Okonkwo

I stayed three nights at Harbour Lodge on a work trip and would broadly recommend it, with one reservation.

questions.prompt: 153. What does the reviewer praise most?

options.text: It is at the lower end of the market.

questions.explanationVi: 'unusually for this price bracket' và 'not something I can say about most hotels at this rate' — hàm ý khách sạn này rẻ hơn mức chất lượng nó cung cấp.

155. In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3] and [4] does the following sentence best belong?

'That said, the problem is entirely fixable and has nothing to do with the rooms.'

activities.title: Part 7 — Single passage 5: article
activities.instructionsVi: Bài báo ngắn. Có một câu hỏi NOT — dạng này buộc kiểm tra cả bốn phương án, chậm nhưng bắt buộc.
activities.promptEn: Refer to the following article and answer the questions.
activities.passage:
FAIRPORT — Coastal Freight has announced that it will open a fourth distribution hub, at Kirby, in September.

The company said the site would create around ninety jobs, of which roughly sixty would be new positions and the remainder transfers from the Fairport depot, which is operating close to capacity.

Chief Executive Dorota Nowak said the decision followed two years of growth in container volume, though she acknowledged that margins had narrowed over the same period. 'Volume without capacity is not growth, it is queuing,' she said at the announcement.

Handling more freight is pointless without somewhere to process it.

activities.title: Part 7 — Single passage 6: instructions
activities.instructionsVi: Hướng dẫn sử dụng. Câu hỏi hay nhắm vào thứ tự các bước và vào điều bị CẤM làm.
activities.promptEn: Refer to the following instructions and answer the questions.
activities.passage:
MERIDIAN CX-40 — Filter replacement

Before you begin: switch the unit off at the wall and wait ten minutes for the internal components to cool. Do not remove the front panel while the unit is still warm.

1. Release the two clips at the base of the front panel and lift the panel away. It is not hinged and will come off completely.
2. Slide the used filter out towards you. Note the arrow printed on its edge — the new filter must be fitted with the arrow pointing the same way.
3. Wipe the filter housing with a dry cloth. Do not use water or cleaning fluid inside the housing.
4. Fit the new filter and refit the panel until both clips engage.
5. Reset the service counter by holding the MODE button for five seconds. The display will show 'F0' when the counter has reset.

If the display continues to show 'F1' after resetting, the filter has been fitted the wrong way round. Remove it and check the arrow.

options.text: Wipe the housing with a damp cloth
Switch off the unit and wait ten minutes

The filter is fitted the wrong way round.

activities.title: Part 7 — Single passage 7: online chat, four writers
activities.instructionsVi: Hội thoại nhóm trực tuyến. Phải theo dõi AI nói gì; câu hỏi hàm ý nhắm vào một câu cụ thể của một người cụ thể.

activities.title: Part 7 — Single passage 8: press release
activities.instructionsVi: Thông cáo báo chí, bốn câu hỏi. Có một câu chèn câu và một câu hỏi từ vựng theo ngữ cảnh — hai dạng khó nhất của Part 7.
activities.promptEn: Refer to the following press release and answer the questions.

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
Riverside Print acquires Bellamy Bindery

FAIRPORT, 3 May — Riverside Print has today announced the acquisition of Bellamy Bindery, a family-owned finishing business operating in the region since 1962.

'The two businesses are therefore already familiar with each other's standards.'

EMAIL
